name: European Open Rivers Programme
summary: Grants to prepare for and carry out removal of small dams and weirs across Greater Europe, including barrier identification, pre-demolition work and demolition. No matching funds are required, except that public entities leading a dam removal grant must cover at least 50% of project costs.

amount.note: Cap applies to barrier identification and prioritisation grants only; most other grants have no maximum

deadline.quote: Submit your project proposal by 13:00 CET on 13th November 2026.

applicant_types.quote: a public entity applying as a lead partner for a Category A3 "Dam removal" grant must provide at least 50% of project costs

geography.quote: The Open Rivers Programme supports projects within Greater Europe.

access.quote: Applications must be submitted through our online portal during the open call period.

window.quote: Open call: apply by 13:00 CET on 13th November 2026!

amount.quote: we apply a maximum cap of €100,000 for barrier identification and prioritisation projects

co_finance_required.quote: There are no matching funding requirements.

administered_by.quote: a new not-for-profit entity (ANBI status), "Stichting European Open Rivers Programme", was established in the Netherlands on 25 June 2021 to manage and implement the programme
